observations: Photo 0 shows two front headlight assemblies.
Photo 1 shows a front radiator grill with a Toyota emblem.
The headlights have clear lenses and integrated indicators.
The grill has vertical slats and a grey/chrome finish.
The items appear used with some surface dust.
The seller's text mentions 'tailight' but no taillights are pictured.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a front radiator grill.
No manufacturer stamps or part numbers are visible in the photos.
Photos are taken from a distance; fine cracks or lens crazing cannot be ruled out.
The rear of the items, where most clips are located, is not shown.
The headlights are not shown powered on.

risks.proof: Photos of the back of the grill and both headlight units.
risks.if_unproven: as broken or requiring improvised mounting

risks.proof: A video showing all light functions (high/low beam, indicators) working.
Close-up photos of the 'TOYOTA' or 'KOITO' stamps on the plastic housings.

proof_requests: Photos of the back of the headlights and the grill to inspect clips and stamps.
Close-up photos of the manufacturer stamps (e.g., Toyota, Koito) on the parts.
A video showing the headlights powered on and functioning.
Clarification on the 'tailight' description vs the headlight photos.
response.reason: The seller's description of 'tailight' is contradicted by the photos showing headlights. Additionally, there is no visual evidence to support the claim of 'Original Toyota' parts or the integrity of the mounting clips.
